what: A big circle of letters — an all-caps line of ”thank you” in many languages stretched to fit exactly around the circle — turns once every 200 seconds, linear (at 1024px and below it is .7x the length, 140 seconds). Fixed half outside one side of the screen and laid down faintly, it becomes a background pattern that every section passes over

options.text: Text to wrap, default is the aria-label of the attached element (; Text that includes a colon goes in aria-label)
options.sep: Joint between the end and start of the text, default ” · ” — to join with a single space use space (leading and trailing spaces in option values are trimmed)
options.repeat: How many times the text wraps per rotation, default 1
options.size: Text size (based on a circle diameter of 1000), default 54 — weight --kf-weight-display, font --kf-font-display, color comes from the element’s color
options.inset: From the circle edge to the top of the text (based on diameter 1000), default 4
options.start: Initial rotation (deg), default 0 — text starts at the 9 o’clock position and runs upward around
options.--fx-dur: Length of one loop (via style), default 200s
options.--fx-dur-narrow: Length at 1024px and below (via style), default --fx-dur × .7
options.--fx-dir: When reverse is on, it spins backwards (via style)
options.--fx-ease: Curve of one revolution (via style), default linear — with ease each turn starts slowly, speeds up, then slows
options.--fx-delay: Delay before the first spin starts (via style), default 0s
options.fit: When off, the text isn’t stretched around the circle but wraps with its own letter spacing (a ring covering only part of the circle, like ”Play The Full Movie”) — default on
options.pause: On hover it pauses while the hand is over it (resort video button — animation-play-state: paused)
options.case: If keep, text is not converted to uppercase (default uppercase)

note: The original placed a glyph-outline SVG image as an img and rotated it. The part takes text and draws it as an SVG textPath so the text can be changed. The size grows with the element width (square).
